[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Domain: Restaurant Management  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Learning Objective: Teach effective decision-making skills in the context of restaurant management, including addressing customer complaints, managing staff, and making financial decisions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Title: A Taste of Success  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Introduction: "A Taste of Success," an immersive e-learning course that puts you in the role of a restaurant manager.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Scenario 1: Customer Complaint  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Situation: A customer approaches you, visibly upset about finding a hair in their meal.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 1A: Apologize and offer a full refund.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 1B: Apologize and offer a complimentary dessert.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 1C: Explain that it must have come from the customer's own head.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Feedback 1A: Good choice! Offering a full refund shows that you take customer satisfaction seriously and are willing to accept responsibility for any mistakes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Feedback 1B: This is an acceptable response, but offering a full refund might have been a better option to ensure complete customer satisfaction.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Feedback 1C: This is not a good response. Blaming the customer is unprofessional and can lead to negative reviews and a loss of customers.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Scenario 2: Staff Management  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Situation: Your lead server calls in sick on a busy Friday night, leaving your team short-staffed.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 2A: Call in another server on their day off.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 2B: Distribute the extra workload among the remaining servers.
